local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local energy=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Energy")
local last=energy.Value

local sparkle=Instance.new("Sound")
sparkle.Name="LegendaryEnergySparkle"
sparkle.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
sparkle.Volume=.55
sparkle.PlaybackSpeed=1.45
sparkle.Parent=SoundService

local finish=Instance.new("Sound")
finish.Name="LegendaryEnergyFinish"
finish.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
finish.Volume=.45
finish.PlaybackSpeed=1.9
finish.Parent=SoundService

local token=0
local function legendaryPickup()
 token+=1
 local mine=token
 sparkle:Play()
 task.delay(.08,function()
  if mine==token then finish:Play() end
 end)
end

energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
 local now=energy.Value
 if now>last then legendaryPickup() end
 last=now
end)
